description: This is a Python source file implementing a WebRTC-based chatbot with idle user detection, speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and LLM integration, using Pipecat framework components.

classes.description: Defines the sequence of processing steps for the chatbot.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates a pipeline with parameters and timeout settings.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
